responsibility: Implements the public Arm C Language Extensions header for non-NEON Arm intrinsics. It exposes inline wrappers and macros around backend builtins for coprocessor access, DSP and saturation operations, Q-bit and GE-bit related intrinsics, CRC instructions, and other scalar ACLE interfaces, while using target-feature preprocessor guards and targeted pragmas to present the correct API for the active Arm architecture and ABI.
